countReconciliation: QĐ1523 declares 36 amended procedures. The annex contains 39 authority-level rows because procedure codes 1.009714, 1.012564 and 1.014056 each apply at both provincial and commune level. Therefore 39 authority rows represent 36 unique amended procedures; no count contradiction remains.
precedence: Latest applicable official source wins; QĐ5230 supersedes QĐ1523 for căn cước rows where both apply.
